reason: NONE. What I noticed first was "200 mg" on the front, and then that it is two capsules per sachet, so it is 100 mg per capsule, which is at least stated honestly. The sachets are handy for travel, but I stick with Pure Encapsulations or Thorne, and a brand with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal does not get my money.
objection: A brand nobody has reviewed and no NSF or USP seal. Their own lab and a QR code is the company grading itself, and $29.99 for 30 days is more than I pay for a brand I already trust.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, plus a few hundred real verified reviews, or a lower price for a first trial box.
